questions.question: 24 students collected money for donation. The average contribution was Rs. 50. Later on, their teacher also contributed some money. Now the average contribution is Rs. 56. The teacher’s contribution is:
questions.solution:
Average contribution of 24 students = 50

Sum of contribution of 24 students = 50 × 24 = 1200

Average contribution of 25 persons (24 students and 1 teacher) = 56

Sum of contribution of 25 persons = 56 × 25 = 1400

∴ Contribution of teacher = 1400 – 1200 = 200

**Short Trick:**

Contribution of teacher = 24 × (56 – 50) + 56 = 144 + 56 = 200

questions.question: Two cyclists X and Y start at the same time from place A and go towards place B at a speed of 6 km/h and 8 km/h, respectively. Despite stopping for 15 minutes during the journey, Y reaches 10 minutes earlier than X. The distance between the places A and B is:
questions.solution:
Speed of X = 6 km and speed of Y = 8 km

Speed ratio of X and Y = 6 : 8 = 3 : 4

Time ratio of X and Y = 4 : 3

As we know, Time is inversely proportional to speed.

The time difference = 15 min + 10 min = 25 min

4 – 3 unit = 1 unit

1 unit = 25 min

Time taking by X = 4 × 25 = 100 min = 100/60 hr

Distance covered by X in 100/60 hr = 100/60 × 6 = 10 km.

**The distance between A and B = 10 km.**

questions.question: Amit and Sunil together can complete a work in 9 days, Sunil and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 12 days, and Amit and Dinesh together can complete the same work in 18 days. In how many days will they complete the work if Amit, Sunil and Dinesh work together?
questions.solution:
A = Amit, S = Sunil and D = Dinesh

Total work = LCM of (9, 12 and 18) = 36

Hence, efficiency of A + S = 4

Efficiency of S + D = 3

Efficiency of A + D = 2

Now, Efficiency of A + S + D = (4 + 3 + 2)/2 = 9/2

∴ A, S and D together work in = 36/(9/2) = 4 × 2 = 8 days

questions.question: The coefficient of x in (x – 3y)³ is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

(x – 3y)³

**Calculation:**

(x – 3y)³

⇒ x³ – (3y)³ – 3 × x × 3y (x – 3y)

⇒ x³ – 27y³ – 9x²y + **27xy²**

Hence, coefficient of x = 27y²

questions.question: In a triangle, if the measures of two sides are 5 cm and 8 cm, then the third side can be:
questions.solution:
As we know,

For a triangle, difference of two sides < third side of triangle < addition of third side of triangle

8 – 5 < third side < 8 + 5

⇒ 3 < third side < 13

In given options, only option 3 i.e. 4 cm lies in between required range.

questions.question: In a wallet, there are notes of the denominations Rs. 10 and Rs. 50. The total number of notes is 12. The number of Rs. 10 and Rs. 50 notes are in the ratio of 1 : 2. Total money in the wallet is:
questions.solution:
Total number of notes = 12

Ratio of number of 10 rupees and 50 rupees notes = 1 : 2 = x : 2x

x + 2x = 12

⇒ 3x = 12

⇒ x = 4

Number of 10 rupees notes = 4

Number of 50 rupees notes = 4 × 2 = 8

∴ Total money in the wallet = (4 × 10) + (8 × 50) = 40 + 400 = 440

questions.question:
In the given figure, if AB = 8 cm, AC = 10 cm, ∠ABD = 90° and AD = 17 cm, then the measure of CD is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a590b48dc636baf5facba42f5f81b21c426454d32a4bd18a6fdabcfa149b9901.png]
questions.solution:
AB = 8 cm, AC = 10 cm and AD = 17 cm

∠ABD = 90°

As we know,

In ΔABC,

AC² = AB² + BC²

⇒ 10² = 8² + BC²

⇒ BC² = 100 – 64 = 36

⇒ BC = √36 = 6 cm

In ΔABD,

AD² = AB² + BD²

⇒ 17² = 8² + BD²

⇒ BD² = 289 – 64 = 225

⇒ BD = √225 = 15 cm

∴ CD = BD – BC = 15 – 6 = 9 cm

questions.question: In a school, 4% of the students did not appear for the annual exams. 10% of the students who appeared for the exams could not pass the exam. Out of the remaining students, 50% got distinction marks and 432 students passed the exam but could not get distinction marks. The total number of students in the school is:
questions.solution:
Let total number of students be 100x

Number of students who did not appear = 100x × (4/100) = 4x

Number of appeared students = 100x – 4x = 96x

Number of appeared students who could not pass = 96x × (10/100) = 9.6x

Remaining students who passed = 96x – 9.6x = 86.4x

Number of students who only passed but couldn’t get distinction marks = 86.4x × 1/2 = 43.2x

Now, 43.2x = 432

⇒ x = 432/43.2

⇒ x = 10

∴ Total number of students = 100 × 10 = 1000

questions.question: The largest number which should replace * in the number 2365*4 to make the number divisible by 4 is:
questions.solution:
As we know,

A number is divisible by 4 if its last 2 digit is divisible by 4.

Here the last two digits which can be divisible by 4 are:

24, 44, 64, 84

In the question, it has asked to find the largest number which can replace in tenth place, therefore from the above relation 84 is the highest number whose tenth place is 8.

questions.question: A shopkeeper marked a computer table for Rs. 7,200. He allows a discount of 10% on it and yet makes a profit of 8%. What will be his gain percentage if he does NOT allow any discount?
questions.solution:
** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**

Relation between CP to MP = (100 – Discount) : (100 + Profit)

⇒ (100 – 10) : (100 + 8) = 90 : 108

Let CP = 90 and MP = 108

Profit percentage 108 – 90 = 18

Profit percentage = 18/90 × 100 = 20%

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] Alternate Method__**

Let he MP of the table be Rs. 100

SP of the table = 100 × 90/100 = 90

CP of the table = 90 × (100/108) = 1000/12

For easy calculation take ratio of CP to MP = 1000/12 : 100 = 10 : 12

Profit = 12 – 10 = 2

**∴ Profit percentage = 2/10 × 100 = 20%**

questions.question: Amir borrowed a sum of Rs. 25,000 on simple interest. Bhola borrowed the same amount on compound interest (interest compounded yearly). At the end of 2 years, Bhola had to pay Rs. 160 more interest than Amir. The rate of interest charged per annum is:
questions.solution:
P = 25,000, time = 2 years and Difference = 160

As we know,

The difference between CI and SI for 2 years = Pr²/100²

⇒ 160 = (25,000 × r²)/100 × 100

⇒ r² = 1600/25

⇒ r = √(1600/25) = 40/5

∴ r = 8%
